AtlasVoice — Text to Speech
New: read-along highlighting & listen to selected text. Your player now highlights each sentence (and each word, with supported voices) as it reads aloud, and visitors can select any passage to hear just that part — or click a word to start reading from there. Both are off by default: turn them on under AtlasVoice → Highlight — choose your colors, optionally dim the rest of the article to help readers focus, and enable auto-scroll.
